_readme: mockrag profiles. The server re-reads this file on every request, so
a change here needs no restart.
Each profile is a GROUND TRUTH. Compare what ragmap reports against
the values here; where they disagree the fault is in the scanner, not
in the target. That comparison is the whole point of the rig.
Fields:
observability   O0/O1/O2/O3 - sets the field-visibility defaults
response_shape  openai | anythingllm | dify
chunk_size      window size, in characters
chunk_overlap   overlap between windows, in characters
top_k           how many chunks to return
similarity_threshold  null means NO threshold (irrelevant chunks come back)
retrieval_mode  dense (misses rare literals) | hybrid (catches exact matches)
router          true means retrieval does not run at all for off-corpus queries
cache           true means a repeated query returns instantly
verbatim_guard  true means the system prompt forbids verbatim quoting
expose_usage    whether a token-counter field is returned
error_verbosity quiet | verbose
simulated_framework_trace  langchain | llamaindex | fastapi | chromadb | null
(a FAKE trace, to exercise framework fingerprinting;
it does not represent a real dependency)

o0_opaque._comment: O0 and opaque, but the token counter is on and verbatim extraction is undefended. The thesis in one profile: hiding sources is not a defence.

o0_hardened._comment: O0 plus a verbatim-quoting ban plus no token counter. The least measurable target there is. The control group.

o1_narrative._comment: O1, narrative: no structured source field, but the answer text names the document title. A scanner should leave this at O1/O0 rather than pretend to resolve it; the distinction is a human call.

o2_structured._comment: O2, structural: source identifiers (filename, page, doc_id) are present, chunk text and scores are not.

o3_full._comment: O3, full: chunk text plus similarity score plus identifiers. A scanner should say O3 here without hesitating.

anythingllm_like._comment: The AnythingLLM response shape with the defaults it ships: chunk 1000 / overlap 20, no threshold. Source fields must come back POPULATED even for off-topic and nonsense queries.

dify_like._comment: A TRAP. The source field carries its real Dify name, 'retriever_resources', and it HOLDS the chunk text. A scanner that matches a fixed list of blessed field names will read this O3 target as opaque. It exists to measure exactly that failure.

router_threshold._comment: Router plus similarity threshold, both on. An off-corpus question and a random string must come back WITHOUT retrieval running: empty source list and a markedly lower latency. The gap against an on-topic query is the clean case for latency-based router detection.

cached_hybrid._comment: Semantic cache plus hybrid retrieval. On a repeated query the second call must be noticeably faster; the rare literal ERR-7F3A-QX91 must be FOUND here and missed by the dense profiles.

verbose_errors._comment: The error-verbosity axis. An empty query returns a real traceback plus a fake LangChain/pydantic trace. Exercises framework fingerprinting.
